latest_release.name: cmus 2.13.0 «2k26»
latest_release.body:
I am happy to announce a new cmus release, two years after the last one, containing many bugfixes by the members of the community, most notably @ihy123, and a few new features.

## What's Changed
* Set the minimum requested AAudio buffer capacity by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1386
* Check for libavutil pkg-config by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1388
* [CI] Update dependency list to fix ubuntu build setup by @gavtroy in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1414
* Add sort by duration by @hunkyburrito in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1440
* Respect scroll_offset setting when resizing window by @gavtroy in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1413
* Try to fallback to any plugin upon failure to init output plugin by @WalrusDevil in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1416
* PulseAudio bugfixes and APPLICATION_ID @ihy123 in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1405
* ip/ffmpeg fixes and ffmpeg 8.0 support by @ihy123 in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1444
* CUE handling improvements and replaygain/genre support @ihy123 in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1406
* Fix for missing Icecast streaming bitrate display. by @thecloudexpanse in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1451
* op/mixer_alsa: alsamixer's volume scale; setting mixer control like aplay does it by @ihy123 in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1445
* ip/ffmpeg: fix seeking and compiler warning about %lld by @ihy123 in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1454
* Fix libmp4v2 check by @gavtroy in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1458
* Make sure to not try freeing an uninitialized pointer by @xant in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1463
* op/alsa: remove polling for events before pause (fixes #1461) by @ihy123 in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1462
* A line of code To improve CommiT b4252db by @4rrimeki in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1467
* Fix unterminated-string-initialization warnings by @chggr in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1472
* Fix stringop-truncation warning by @chggr in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1473
* Standardise in using xmalloc by @chggr in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1478
* Fix memory leak in bass.c by @chggr in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1477
* Fix compiler warning about uninitialized rb_parent_color by @chggr in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1484
* op/aaudio: fix dsp.aaudio.sharing_mode getter by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1508
* Properly handle directory listing errors in browser by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1509
* Fix old colors being left behind when applying an incomplete theme by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1510
* Define _XOPEN_SOURCE so wcwidth can be found by @gavtroy in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1498
* Pass playback position to status_display_program by @leana8959 in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1502
* Do not delete missing files from playlists. by @jchook in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1470
* op/aaudio: fix remap buffer size by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1511
* ip/wavpack: don't leak fd on failure by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1517
* Fix buffer overflow caused by invalid UTF-8 by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1520
* ip/opus: fix opusfile callbacks and fdsan abort on invalid files by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1518
* mpris: set xesam:url by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1521
* Make :clear -p work properly for playlists by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1523
* Add auto_mark_selected_playlist option by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1524
* mpris: report the correct position in Seeked by @pgaskin in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1522
* Silence clang warnings by @gavtroy in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1533

## New Contributors
* @hunkyburrito made their first contribution in https://github.com/cmus/cmus/pull/1440
* @WalrusDevil made their firs
